mapper.insert:
insert into setmeal_dish (setmeal_id, dish_id, name, price, copies) values
(#{sd.setmealId}, #{sd.dishId}, #{sd.name}, #{sd.price}, #{sd.copies})
mapper.select: SELECT sd.dish_id AS dishId, sd.name, sd.price, sd.copies, d.image FROM setmeal_dish sd LEFT JOIN dish d ON sd.dish_id = d.id WHERE sd.setmeal_id = #{setmealId}
